traits.name: Carrion Scent
traits.text: An angheuvore can smell creatures that have the doomed, dying, or wounded condition as an imprecise sense. Items composite shortbow (20 arrows), elven curve blade.

traits.name: Items
traits.text: composite shortbow (20 arrows), elven curve blade;

traits.name: Consecration Vulnerability
traits.text: An angheuvore in a place of worship dedicated to a non-evil deity or on sacred ground, such as an area blessed by sanctified ground, is slowed 1.

traits.name: Death Gasp
traits.text: ⬻ (divine, necromancy); The angheuvore draws in a deep breath and holds it, temporarily suspending their biological processes and becoming undead. The angheuvore gains the undead trait and becomes immune to bleed, death effects, disease, paralyzed, poison, and sleep. Any such effects the angheuvore is currently suffering from are suspended, but take effect again once they take a breath.

traits.name: Death
traits.text: Gasp lasts as long as the angheuvore holds their breath (up to 8 rounds, Core Rulebook 478).

traits.name: Invigorating Feast
traits.text: ⬻ (manipulate); Requirements The angheuvore is adjacent to a paralyzed, restrained, or unconscious creature, or a deceased creature that died in the last hour Effect The angheuvore feasts upon the creature, dealing their jaws Strike damage (basic Fortitude save); a corpse automatically critically fails with no save. If the target takes damage, the angheuvore gains 5 temporary Hit Points and a +10-foot circumstance bonus to their Speeds for 1 minute.

traits.name: Paralysis
traits.text: (divine, incapacitation, necromancy); Any living creature hit by an angheuvore's jaws Strike must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save or become paralyzed. It can attempt a new save to end the condition at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each save.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ elven curve blade +10 (finesse, forceful); Damage 1d8+5 (1d8+5) slashing

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ composite shortbow +10 (deadly d10, propulsive, range increment 60 feet); Damage 1d6+3 (1d6+3) piercing
